raw_entities.name: SmartSaver Account Interest Accrual
raw_entities.description: FAQ addressing customer questions about how interest is calculated and accrued on SmartSaver Account balances. This item clarifies the mechanics of interest application to customer funds.

raw_entities.name: SmartSaver Account Eligibility
raw_entities.description: FAQ addressing customer questions about who can open and hold a SmartSaver Account. This item clarifies the eligibility criteria and requirements for account access.

raw_entities.name: SmartSaver Account Fees and Charges
raw_entities.description: FAQ addressing customer questions about fees, charges, and costs associated with holding and operating a SmartSaver Account. This item clarifies the fee structure and when charges apply.

raw_entities.name: SmartSaver Account Access and Withdrawal
raw_entities.description: FAQ addressing customer questions about how to access funds, make withdrawals, and manage account access. This item clarifies the operational procedures for account access.

raw_entities.name: SmartSaver Account Security
raw_entities.description: FAQ addressing customer questions about account security, fraud protection, and safeguarding of funds. This item clarifies the security measures and protections in place.

raw_entities.name: SmartSaver Account
raw_entities.description: A savings account product offered by FirstUK Bank, referenced throughout the FAQ documentation as a primary customer-facing savings product. The account is subject to interest accrual, eligibility requirements, fee structures, and security protections.

raw_entities.name: FirstUK Bank
raw_entities.description: The issuing financial institution providing the SmartSaver Account and other banking products referenced in this FAQ documentation.
